lines.text: At the last Super Bowl, suites started around six hundred thousand dollars.
Sixteen tickets. A private room. The field right below.
Split sixteen ways: thirty-seven thousand five hundred a seat.
Food isn't always included. One stadium burger cost a hundred eighty dollars.
Catering, staff and security reportedly add thirty-five percent or more.
Fly private, and one landing in San Jose can cost twenty-five thousand.
Suite plus add-ons: about eight hundred ten thousand dollars.
Fifty grand a guest, for one game. Suite or cash?
